verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com that indexes Plugins docs, plus a plugins-specific llms.txt at /plugins/llms.txt. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md) versions that link back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on pointing agents at these files, and independent community corroboration of agents consuming them in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
